purpose: Curated seed dictionary for receipt-line ingredient matching, pantry identity and recipe ingredient resolution.
design_principles: Ingredient family identifies the broad ingredient; a variant captures a meaningful culinary or formulation difference.
Different brands of the same confirmed variant resolve to the same variant ID.
Different meaningful variants remain separate pantry entries.
If a receipt only identifies the family, use its unspecified variant rather than guessing a specific variant.
Original receipt descriptions and purchase evidence should be retained outside this catalogue for traceability.

matching_policy.unknown_variant_policy: Use the family unspecified variant when the family is confidently identified; do not infer a specific variant from a generic description.
matching_policy.ambiguous_match_policy: Send for user review instead of silently assigning an uncertain ingredient or variant.

count.note: Slice-to-piece equivalence is only a count convention; it does not imply a loaf-to-slice conversion.

package.rule: Do not convert package units to mass, volume or count without explicit net content or a verified product-specific pack definition.
